GX16 plates

Plain plates for the control box front, on the new panel rules. Front face shown first; flip to see the back. Black PETG, print face down. Drag to orbit, scroll or pinch to zoom.

Panel rules (all panels from now on)

  • Countersunk M3: Ø3.4 hole with a 90° countersink to Ø6.4, so a flat head sits just under flush.
  • Rivnut relief: Ø9 × 1.2 pocket in the back over each rivnut flange (Ø8 measured, 1.0 thick assumed).
  • 2 mm lip: a 2 mm wide, 2 mm tall frame on the back, 0.3 mm inside the steel opening all round. It locates the plate and leaves the socket clamp at 3 mm.

These plates

  • 3 mm plate, GX16 holes Ø16.2 (plain round, no key).
  • Steppers 92 × 85, servo 44 × 58, endstops 78 × 58.
  • Plates grew 2 mm on the rivnut sides so the reliefs stay inside the edge. The steel is unchanged.
  • Screws: 7 × M3 × 6 countersunk (3 + 2 + 2). Length is a guess: 3 plate + 1.2 steel into the rivnut.
